[TOOL_CALLS] [**Run query_graph**](https://github.com/buildingsmith/builder/blob/main/docs/metadata/brick.md#metadata-graph)

```
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX ref: <https://purl.org/rdfs/brick/references/>
PREFIX brick: <https://purl.org/rdfs/brick/>
SELECT DISTINCT ?ts_id WHERE {
  ?p a brick:Building .
  ?p ref:hasExternalReference "4a6NdhPyi9V99wM9g35iPw" .
  ?p ref:hasTimeseriesId ?ts_id
}
```
